name: Microsoft COCO (Common Objects in Context)
description: Microsoft Common Objects in Context (MS COCO) is a foundational large-scale computer vision dataset designed for object detection, instance segmentation, keypoint detection, and image captioning. It contains over 330,000 images (more than 200,000 labeled) featuring 1.5 million object instances across 80 common object categories, 91 stuff categories, and 5 independent human-written captions per image.
